versions.name: Camp Brosig
versions.summary: A primitive Sam Houston Area Council weekend camping property in Austin County north of Sealy, Texas, offering campsites, program fields, and a covered pavilion for troop, crew, and ship camping and district events.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Sam Houston Area Council camp page (shacbsa.org/camp-brosig), which confirms it as an active 92-acre weekend camping property. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
